newsitem.title: FINLAND: KONECRANES SEES GROWTH, GOOD MARGINS.
newsitem.headline: KONECRANES SEES GROWTH, GOOD MARGINS.

text.p: Finnish crane maker KCI Konecranes International Oy said on Wednesday it expected growth in all business areas and a favourable trend in margins.

"KCI Konecranes' future looks good. With the refocusing of special cranes now behind us, we can expect consistent good organic sales growth in all business areas," KCI said in a statement with its preliminary 1996 results.
It reported a 54 percent increase in its 1996 profit after financial items to 208.2 million markka.

"Margins development is also likely to be favorable. Margins will expand in monetary value, however, costs relating to integrating acquired companies as well as training costs within maintenance services keep percentage gains low."
"In equipment sales (special cranes and standard lifting equipment) growth will be particularly strong in the Asia-Pacific region," it said.
"In the Nordic countries we expect a slower market," Konecranes said.
Business in central Europe showed signs of increasing, the company said.
"In western Europe and the U.S., equipment markets are mature. However, our maintenance services activcities operate here in a true growth environment," KCI Konecranes said.
The company's market presence through its maintenance services unit would help it achieve "better-than-market growth" also in equipment sales, it said.
"Yet, these growth expectations are lower than for Asia-Pacific equipment sales," it said.
